actions.action: Slide the plant out of its pot and check for circling roots
Repot in spring into a pot 1-2 inches larger with drainage holes if root-bound
Mix perlite or pumice into the potting soil
Water thoroughly once the top 2 inches of soil are dry
Move the plant to brighter indirect light if far from a window
Flush the soil with water every few months to remove salt buildup

reason: The answer blames a root-bound pot and slow growth and never recognizes the multiple tangled money trees, so repotting one size up would not separate them. Its advice is standard care and not likely to hurt the plant.
